changes: Exact-endpoint secret_env mapping; no global fallback.
Grant only after positive channel/credit hold or verified x402; federation sales/resales only, never routing fees.
No grant for free/sandbox calls; buyer header stripped.
HTTPS default, per-endpoint HTTP opt-in; rewrites require two explicit mappings to the same secret.
No redirect following or ambient proxy discovery on credential-bearing requests.
